title: Deleting a todo while a filter is active removes the wrong item
observed_steps: 00:01 - Add 'Buy milk', 'Walk dog', and 'Pay rent' to the todo list
00:05 - Click the 'Active' filter button so only 'Walk dog' and 'Pay rent' are shown
00:07 - Click the delete (×) button on 'Pay rent'
00:09 - Switch back to the 'All' filter and observe 'Buy milk' and 'Pay rent' remain while 'Walk dog' is gone
expected: Clicking the delete button on 'Pay rent' in the Active filter should delete 'Pay rent' and leave 'Walk dog' in the list.
actual: Clicking the delete button on 'Pay rent' (index 1 of the filtered list) deletes 'Walk dog' (index 1 of the unfiltered todos array), leaving 'Pay rent' in the list.
evidence_timestamps: 00:04 — 'Buy milk' is checked as done above 'Walk dog' and 'Pay rent' in the All view
00:05 — Active filter is selected, showing only 'Walk dog' and 'Pay rent'
00:07 — After clicking delete on 'Pay rent', 'Walk dog' disappears and 'Pay rent' remains visible
00:09 — Switching to the All filter shows 'Buy milk' and 'Pay rent', confirming 'Walk dog' was deleted instead
root_cause_hypothesis: In app/public/app.js, render() iterates over the filtered array returned by visibleTodos() with items.forEach((t, i) => ...) and binds each delete button to deleteTodo(i) (line 79). deleteTodo(index) (lines 36-41) then calls todos.splice(index, 1) on the unfiltered todos array. When a filter hides preceding items, the filtered index i does not match the item's position in todos, causing the wrong todo to be spliced and deleted via DELETE /api/todos/${t.id}.
